keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Osasuna 1, Malaga 0. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Valentin Rosier with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Adrián Niño (Malaga).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Malaga. Ramón Enríquez replaces Rafa Rodríguez.
Substitution, Malaga. Carlos Puga replaces Álex Pastor.
Second Half begins Osasuna 1, Malaga 0.
Substitution, Malaga. Dani Lorenzo replaces Joaquín Muñoz.
Substitution, Osasuna. Asier Osambela replaces Aimar Oroz.
Substitution, Osasuna. Raúl Moro replaces Kike Barja.
Asier Osambela (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Diego Murillo (Malaga).
Substitution, Osasuna. Iker Muñoz replaces Rubén García.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Osasuna. Lucas Torró replaces Moi Gómez.
Substitution, Malaga. Chupe replaces Pablo Martínez.
Substitution, Malaga. Juan Cruz replaces David Larrubia.
Substitution, Osasuna. Raúl García replaces Ante Budimir.
Raúl García (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card.
Second yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Osasuna 1, Malaga 0.
